question: The fifth and sixth five-year plans were majorly focused on which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce poverty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The fifth and sixth five-year plans of India were crucial in addressing **poverty alleviation** and aimed at reducing poverty levels significantly.
 
• The **Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979)** introduced the Minimum Needs Programme (MNP) and aimed at achieving self-reliance and reducing poverty.
